events.text: A truck-ramming attack was made on the Christmas market at Breitscheidplatz, killing twelve people and injuring 48 others.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 19 December 2016, at about 20:00 local time, a truck-ramming attack was made on the Christmas market at Breitscheidplatz

events.text: In preparation for the Christmas market 2018, the square and its surrounding were fortified against further terrorist attacks.
